briefdescription.para: The planned bytes.

detaileddescription.para: The callable constructor builds them, and the Myers constructor leaves them empty.

briefdescription.para: Ordered list of line-level changes.
The offset and the size of each inserted line, in the bytes that appendUnifiedDiff receives.

detaileddescription.para: A change refers to its lines through its insertedRange. The offset indexes plannedText for the callable constructor, and the bytes of the target document for the Myers constructor.

briefdescription.para: Creates a diff with no changes.
Builds the changes and the planned bytes in one pass, from a callable that adds the changes.

detaileddescription.para: The callable receives addChange, and calls it as addChange (start, length, insertedText) for each change, in ascending order of start. The inserted text replaces the length lines from start. A nullopt text is a deletion. Each inserted line takes the line ending of the original line that it replaces, or the line ending of the document when no original line is replaced.

parameterdescription.para: Callable that accepts the addChange callable.
The document before the changes.
The callable that adds the changes.

briefdescription.para: Computes the shortest line-level edit script from original to target using Myers diff.

detaileddescription.para: The inserted lines are offsets into the bytes of target, so the bytes of target must not change while this diff is used. No planned bytes are built, so getPlannedBytes is empty.

parameterdescription.para: Baseline document before edits.
Target document after edits.

briefdescription.para: Returns the planned bytes that the changes produce.

detaileddescription.para: The view is empty for the Myers constructor, because its inserted lines index the bytes of the target document.

simplesect.para: The planned bytes. The view is valid while this diff lives.

briefdescription.para: Appends unified diff hunks between original and plannedBytes.

detaileddescription.para: Changes that lie within 2 * 3 unchanged lines of each other share one hunk. Each hunk has up to three unchanged context lines before and after its changes, limited by the document bounds.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the unified diff. Nothing is appended when the diff holds no changes.
Document before changes.
The bytes that the inserted lines index: getPlannedBytes() for the callable constructor, or the bytes of the target document for the Myers constructor.

briefdescription.para: Removes one trailing line feed from a payload text, and the carriage returns beside it.

detaileddescription.para: Each inserted line takes a line ending from the document. A payload that ends in a line feed would add one empty line, so the trailing line feed is removed. The carriage return before that line feed is removed too, and then one more trailing carriage return, when present.

parameterdescription.para: The payload text.

simplesect.para: The text without its trailing line feed and carriage returns.

The number of lines in the range.

briefdescription.para: Appends the original lines before a change, then the inserted lines of the change.

detaileddescription.para: Each inserted line takes the line ending of the original line that it replaces, or the document line ending when it replaces none. So the line endings of the original are kept. The offset and the size of each inserted line are recorded in insertedLines.

parameterdescription.para: The document before the changes.
The first original line that the change replaces.
The number of original lines that the change replaces.
The inserted text, or nullopt for a deletion.
The line ending of the last piece that was appended, or nullopt before the first piece.

simplesect.para: The line ending of the last piece that was appended. An empty ending is an incomplete last line.

briefdescription.para: Appends the original lines from startLine up to endLine, which the changes do not touch.

detaileddescription.para: The run is written with the line ending of its last line. An empty ending, which means an incomplete last line, is returned, so that the next piece can write the document line ending first.

The zero-based index of the first line of the run.
The zero-based index that ends the run, exclusive.
The line ending of the last piece that was appended, or nullopt before the first piece.

memberdef.name: appendWithEnding

briefdescription.para: Appends a piece of text and its line ending to the planned bytes.

detaileddescription.para: When the previous piece had an empty line ending, the document line ending is written first. That case is an incomplete last line, which needs a line ending before more text can follow it.

parameterdescription.para: The document before the changes. Its line ending is the default.
The text of the piece, without its line ending.
The line ending of the piece. It may be empty.
The line ending of the previous piece, or nullopt before the first piece.

briefdescription.para: Sets the end of the planned bytes after the last change, and completes an incomplete last line.

detaileddescription.para: The original lines after the last change are appended. The planned bytes end with a line ending only when the original ends with one, when the last change deletes the final line, or when the document is empty. Otherwise the line ending that was appended last is removed. An insertion after an incomplete last line takes that line into the change as a replaced line, because the line gets a line ending in the planned bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The document before the changes.
The line ending of the last piece that was appended.
